title: Image/OCR/Imagegen workflow closure
notes: S6 is a Web-only status/action-plan closure. It does not call external model APIs or install OCR dependencies during status rendering.
Fast OCR missing dependencies map to repair_fast_ocr instead of a generic prompt-driven repair.
Vision/imagegen provider credential absence maps to configure_model_provider, so missing keys are not reported as missing runtime tools.
Image generation remains pinned to gpt-image-2-pro in the visual workflow contract.
Configured provider detection exposes provider IDs only; serialized visualWorkflow does not include raw provider keys.
OCR-missing with configured vision credentials reports overall.state=degraded and overall.visionFallbackAvailable=true.

Web /api/capabilities and /api/extensions construct RuntimeCapabilityRegistry with probe_installer_status=false so status GETs do not create state directories or run install-capability.py --action status.
